title: MIAShield: Defending Membership Inference Attacks via Preemptive Exclusion of Members
reasoning: The paper focuses on defending against membership inference attacks to protect user privacy in machine learning. While privacy is an ethical concern, the paper does not involve evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, spiritual traditions, theology, epistemology, hermeneutics, morals, or ethics as a core component of its methodology or evaluation. The ethical considerations are related to data privacy rather than the content or reasoning of the models regarding moral or religious topics.
